data.long_meaning: This beautiful name Naaz is derived from the Arabic word 'naz', which means 'grace' or 'beauty'. It is also a name of a heavenly angel in Islamic tradition. This name carries the essence of divine grace and beauty, and is an excellent choice for parents who wish to bestow their child with such qualities. The name Naaz carries the meaning “Grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Naaz usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
